visual_records.analytical_purpose: Expose the full proposed model-to-decision chain before details.
visual_records.exact_reading: The Abstract runs from AQI as an Earth-health proxy through local BP-PSO networks, a global feedback network, autonomous forecasts, verification, critical nodes, and country decisions.
visual_records.next_action: Treat every stage as a preview and verify it against the body.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Motivate the need for a predictive global environmental model.
visual_records.exact_reading: A cited World3 chart places population, industrial output, food, resources, and pollution on a long-run scenario curve.
visual_records.next_action: Use the authors' interpretation only; do not count third-party figure wording as positive prose.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Support the inventory of human and environmental drivers.
visual_records.exact_reading: Three cited panels juxtapose increasing human activity with global Earth-system changes.
visual_records.next_action: Trace each retained factor to data and avoid treating visual co-movement as causality.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Define the paper's local air-quality output.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 1 maps AQI intervals to six health categories from Good through Hazardous.
visual_records.next_action: Keep pollutant breakpoints, averaging periods, and national aggregation limits explicit.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Stabilize notation before the architecture is introduced.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 2 defines linked-network inputs, outputs, local feedback, global feedback, states, weights, and time indices.
visual_records.next_action: Reconcile every table symbol with the later equations and forecast modes.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Make the two-level recurrence and information handoffs visible.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 3 shows local neural networks connected through a global network, with stepwise and autonomous update paths.
visual_records.next_action: Publish architecture, timing, tensor dimensions, and executable update order.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Define recurrence and the claimed global-health interface.
visual_records.exact_reading: The state vector and prose-derived autonomous handoff feed local outputs forward, while W and a weighted mean H aggregate node outputs.
visual_records.next_action: Specify weight construction, dimensions, normalization, and a stable forecast horizon.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Make model selection depend on available data.
visual_records.exact_reading: Table 3 separates a data-light basic link from a conditional advanced physical model requiring richer factor information.
visual_records.next_action: Do not report the advanced model as implemented until its inputs and validation exist.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Connect country forecasts through a global feedback signal.
visual_records.exact_reading: Incoming F sums f over prior AQI-like output, country area, and distance; f grows through both distance-dependent power and exponential terms.
visual_records.next_action: Audit units and reverse or justify distance amplification before reuse.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Separate a conditional physical link from the implemented verification proxy.
visual_records.exact_reading: A Gaussian plume is proposed, while E/S and linear range scaling actually construct AQI-like targets from country emissions.
visual_records.next_action: Validate pollutant compatibility, units, breakpoints, deletions, plume physics, and target bias.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Check whether the local learner can reproduce held-out behavior.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 4 overlays an observed Belgium series and a forecast that broadly follows the central trend but misses local variation.
visual_records.next_action: Resolve the stepwise-caption versus autonomous-prose conflict and report numeric errors, baselines, seeds, and uncertainty.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Move from local feedback strength to a global criticality rank.
visual_records.exact_reading: G sums an improvised g whose AQI and area powers and positive exponential distance term are intended to represent worldwide influence.
visual_records.next_action: Justify scales, exponents, distance direction, and validation outcomes.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Present candidate nodes for warnings and case analysis.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 5 colors a subset of countries identified as important but shows no complete numeric ranking or selection threshold.
visual_records.next_action: Add a legend, values, full ranking, cutoff, uncertainty, and intervention validation.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Probe sensitivity to one relationship change.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 6 compares India forecasts after training networks with and without China; the actual target is the same but the two predictions fluctuate differently.
visual_records.next_action: Hold splits, parameters, and seeds fixed or avoid claiming that retraining isolates topology.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Visualize a claimed change in global pollution distribution.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 7 presents two color-coded world maps whose darker regions are said to indicate more serious pollution, without a quantitative legend.
visual_records.next_action: Publish the scale, year, country values, missing-data treatment, and uncertainty.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Turn a country forecast into a warning narrative.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 8 starts in 1985 and shows actual and autonomous paths diverging, with a visible jump later labeled a 1993 tipping point.
visual_records.next_action: Predeclare the tipping rule and test the transition, uncertainty, and reversibility against observations.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Connect forecast divergence to a policy case.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 9 contrasts an actual improving path with a lower autonomous path interpreted as what might have occurred without economic reform.
visual_records.next_action: Add policy variables and causal identification before calling the autonomous path a no-reform counterfactual.

visual_records.analytical_purpose: Extend the warning-and-decision narrative to a contrasting country.
visual_records.exact_reading: Figure 10 shows another actual-versus-autonomous divergence and is used to infer a state change and better development choice.
visual_records.next_action: Use a matched policy-aware counterfactual, explicit threshold, and decision loss before recommending a policy.
